record.field: What is the difference between a Commitment and an Expense?
A Commitment reserves money on a budget line before it is spent (e.g. once an Acquisition is committed). An Expense is the actual posted payment; it turns the reserved amount into real, booked cost.
How do I request money for something not yet in the budget?

If a budget line is short, an Acquisition moves to Insufficient Funds and offers three recovery paths: pick a different budget line, request an Internal Budget Transfer, or request Donor Supplementary Funding.
What happens when I clear an Advance?

You report justified expenses against the advance through a Liquidation. Any unspent balance is returned or reimbursed, and Advance Tracking shows what is still outstanding by employee, department or position.
Where do I see how much of a grant's budget is still available?
Use Dashboards > Budget Monitoring for a live planned/committed/actual/available view by grant, or Reporting > Financial Reports > Budget vs Actual for a category-level comparison.
Grant Closure (under Funding & Grants) is restricted to Finance Managers. It verifies outstanding liquidations and computes any funds to be returned to the donor before the grant is marked closed.
